page.layout: One page of text, a contents list in lines; a running title at the top; at the foot a signature line "†† 3" and "233. Sca-" (catchword) at the right.

main_text.l: 218. Antiqua capitularia M. S. carent titulo, &
224. Isidorus Hispalensis, ut à quibusdam dicitur,
225. Vocatur hic Isidorus Peccator vel Mercator
232. Qua versione usus sit Isidorus in sua collectione.

page.notes: The page carries a printed heading "TRACTATIONIS." at the top. Line 233 is the catchword and is also the first word of the next page; its signature "†† 3" is at the foot left. Several words are set in italic and underlined in the scan (e.g. "Quare", "Quid", "Quibus", "Qua"); the ink is faded and some words (suppositerit, Decretales) are uncertain. Parts of the text are blurred by foxing and show-through, so "suppositerit" in 222 and 223 may be "supposuerit" [?]. Greek in line 215 is ΚΕΦΑΛΑΙΑ in the scan.
